thread:
lina: Following the postmortem notes — we need concrete owners and dates for the latency/throughput remediation items. Recurring pattern seems tied to short bursts of long sequences + cache misses.

peter: I can take the cache prefix work. Will add a conservative TTL and instrument hit-rate by model. ETA: Tue EOD.

alex: I'll handle the throughput SLO recalculation proposal. Thinking a targeted, 5-day relaxation for requests tagged model=xl-large during the traffic surge window. Draft will include rollback metric: 99th pct back under 1.1s for 3h. ETA: Wed morning.

maya: I'll own the incident board updates and cross-team notify (CS/PM). Will prepare a short email template and a Slack snippet for product channels. ETA: Today 17:00.

opsbot: Incident board updated: I-6880 created, label=latency-pattern, owners assigned.

lina: Good. One more ask: alerts are firing noise on 95th vs 99th. Let's split alerts and add an explicit error-budget burn alert that uses burn rate over 30m.

alex: Proposed alert rule (staging):
```
alert: ErrorBudgetBurnHigh
expr: increase(sum(rate(error_budget_spent_total[30m])) by (service), 0) > 3
for: 20m
labels:
  severity: page
```
I'll validate metrics names and test in staging Thurs.

peter: For prefix cache, I'll also add a small canary targeting 5% of traffic for models tagged experimental. Canary plan in PR: https://git.internal/r/cache/prefix-cache/pulls/7

lina: For the SLO tweak, prefer cohort-based approach (model header) not global. Alex, include communication checklist: who to notify, what dashboard snapshot to attach, and when to revert.

maya: Draft comms posted: https://docs.internal/comm/incidents/6880-notify.md. Includes CS blurb + chart link.

alex: Also adding a dashboard panel: "Error budget burn by model" + a small visualization of throughput vs 99p latency. Will post link when ready.

peter: Quick note: long sequences (>1500 tokens) cause spikes. I will add a queue cap for those to prevent blocking small requests. That will be in the same PR.

lina: Ownership summary: cache+queue changes = peter; SLO cohort & RFC = alex; communications & tracking = maya. I will track in the weekly ops sync and mark this as "latency-pattern-tracking" series.

peter: Added tasks to I-6880 with milestones and canary schedule. Canary windows: 24h at 5% then 24h at 25% if stable.

maya: I'll send the first comms to PM/CS after Alex posts the RFC.

alex: RFC link posted: https://docs.internal/slo/6880-temporary-adjust.md. Includes cohort def, rollback criteria, and post-carry report template.

lina: OK — next check-in Friday 10:00 to review canary telemetry and error-budget burn. If we see repeat pages before then, annotate the incident with tag "latency-pattern" so we can aggregate for the quarterly postmortem.

peter: Will monitor and report any regressions.

lina: Thanks all, keep updates short in this thread.
